page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c28g1.14xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance built on the x86_64 CPU architecture and powered by KVM hypervisor technology. The instance features 56 dedicated vCPUs along with 224.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a allocation ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. Hardware acceleration is provided by two integrated NVIDIA P4 GPUs delivering a combined total of 16 GB of VRAM.

Networking capabilities include a baseline bandwidth of 10 Gbps. The instance does not include local NVMe or SSD storage, requiring external cloud block storage for persistent data retention and file system operations. Resource efficiency is characterized by the density of 56 host cores paired with dual graphics processors, offering dedicated compute compute density for accelerated tasks without local disk attachment.

Workload fit for the Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c28g1.14xlarge includes AI model inference, video transcoding, image recognition, and general parallel compute operations leveraging dual graphics processing units alongside host memory and core capacity.
description: The Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c28g1.14xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance designed for parallel processing and machine learning inference workloads. Operating on the x86_64 architecture with a KVM hypervisor, this instance supplies 56 dedicated vCPUs alongside 224.0 GB of system memory, representing a 4.0 GB per core allocation. The hardware profile is equipped with two NVIDIA P4 GPUs providing 16 GB of total VRAM to support accelerated compute tasks. Network connectivity is supported by a 10 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. The instance features no local storage, relying on attached cloud block storage for persistent data requirements. The resource density of 56 vCPUs and dual GPUs provides cost-efficient processing capacity for accelerated compute tasks where high local disk throughput is not required. The ecs.gn5i-c28g1.14xlarge is suited for video encoding, deep learning inference, image processing, and parallel execution pipelines.
